newsitem.title: USA: Hatfield says completes $30 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: Hatfield says completes $30 mln private placement.

text.p: Hatfield Quality Meats, a family-owned producer and packager of pork products, said Thursday it has completed a $30-million private placement of senior unsecured notes through a First Union Corp subsidiary, First Union Capital Markets Corp.
Hatfield also received a $25 million five-year revolving credit facility from First Union National Bank, a corporate affiliate of First Union Capital.
Hatfield said it will use proceeds to repay debt, expand existing plant facilities and for general corporate purposes.
First Union Capital is the investment banking subsidiary of First Union Corp.
First Union is a bank holding company which operates in 12 Eastern states.
